name: Telcoin CloneableProxy re-initialisation
summary: Telcoin wallet CloneableProxies were created without their initializer being run, so the OpenZeppelin _initialized flag stayed clear and the master’s initialize(address,bytes) remained callable by anyone. The attacker re-initialised each unused wallet, pointing its beacon slot at a module of their own, and had the wallet delegatecall that module to transfer out its TEL.
notes: The wallet is an EIP-1167 minimal proxy whose runtime, 0x363d3d373d3d3d363d7310d0e9755c67ab37089acb4f51e8b4ee407fe8535af43d82803e903d91602b57fd5bf3, hardcodes the master 0x10d0e9755c67ab37089acb4f51e8b4ee407fe853 and cannot be repointed. The clone creation by the CloneFactory 0x4cf353974155a600f87d73222f9df0548e2b740e is therefore the change that put that code into service for this execution context, and the proxy emitted no Upgraded event before the exploit.

The quantities are exact: netting the 22 transactions the attacker sent to its module between blocks 51546496 and 51553000 gives 3470866212.40 TEL and 37.080124317370778845 LINK moving out of Telcoin wallet proxies into attacker control. The USD figure is the reported one because marking that quantity at the pre-incident spot price is not realisable: TEL fell from 0.002358 to 0.0008175 within five minutes of the drain as the attacker sold, and 3.47 billion TEL at the pre-crash price would be about USD 8.2 million against a realised figure that contemporaneous reporting puts at USD 1.2 to 1.25 million. The components therefore carry quantity only and the USD total is the reported realisation. Nothing was recovered.
